subject: pipeline_coverage.py alias_check has_agent

evidence.quote: A Study to Evaluate HMPL-306 in Patients With IDH1or IDH2-mutated Acute Myeloid Leukemia

proposal: has_agent requires the agent's own generic/INN name (RANOSIDENIB) or a pre-existing sponsor found_term to literally appear in the trial record text. For pre-approval code-name-only agents, CT.gov trials never use the INN, so has_agent is structurally always False and no code-name alias can ever verify this way -- blocks legitimate tier-1 evidence. Proposal: allow verification via a sponsor-attribution cross-check (AACT lead sponsor name matches data/sponsor_links.json pipeline[agent].sponsor) as an alternate path to has_agent when the INN never appears pre-approval.
